messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Rahul Chugh
rahul chugh... solid name. where you working these days?
CRED

cred... kunal shah's credit card playground for the elite. found you on linkedin - mobile engineer building the app that makes rich people feel good about paying bills.

this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/raahulchugh
Yes
mobile at cred... android, flutter, kotlin - you're building the sleek interfaces that make credit card payments feel like a flex. solid stack. what got you into mobile dev in the first place?

makes sense... sleek interfaces are what separate good apps from great ones. and cred definitely nailed that premium feel.

how long you been working total?
Love for sleek interfaces
Can you check that from my linkedin itself?

nah, i don't trust linkedin data for experience... it's usually messy and incomplete. plus people count internships, breaks, overlaps differently.

need the real number from you - how long you been working total?
7 years
What is it from LinkedIn?

yo i already told you - i don't use linkedin for experience data because it's unreliable. some people count college projects, some don't count internships, dates are often wrong.

i need YOUR answer. how long have you been working total? just give me the number.

7 years... that's solid mobile experience. you've probably seen the whole evolution from native to cross-platform chaos.

what kind of role you looking for next?
Lead mobile engineer

lead mobile engineer... 7 years is right in that sweet spot where you can actually lead without just being a glorified senior dev.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Bangalore and gurgaon and remote
7 years + lead mobile engineer + bangalore/gurgaon/remote... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes

yooo rahul! you're officially in the tal network now 🔥

7 years of mobile mastery, lead-level ambitions, and smart enough to stay flexible with location - that's exactly the kind of profile that makes my job fun.

the machine is now working for you. when roles drop that match your vibe, they'll slide right into this chat. no spam, no garbage - just opportunities that actually make sense for where you're at.

welcome to the good side, legend!
Hi
